{{Top|leg}}
'''Portable plasma-incinerator units''' were devices used for sterilization.<ref name="KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

Portable plasma-incinerator units were small enough to be carried by a single individual, and were more than capable of burning through [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferroconcrete]]. They were most notably used during the outbreak of the [[Krytos virus]]; clean teams would take samples from a site where a victim [[Death/Legends|died]], and then burn everything in the area - down to the first five millimeters of ferrocrete - to a white ash to prevent the spread of the virus.<ref name="KT" />
